notes: Audit at main 6f63aaa (read-only). Key truths: (1) The JURNL expression guard stack (#1357-#1364) is a well-tested library but EXISTS_DISCONNECTED — no API/script dispatch path calls precheckGenerationDispatch/runPrecheckedProviderDispatch; OpenArt has no API integration, so enforcement is by agent convention and JSON founder_gate edits; ~48 api/shared files call fal/xAI/OpenAI directly. (2) REFERENCE_F01.00_WELCOME_APPROVED registry paths both missing on disk; the real file is JURNL/F01_ENTRY/PARENT/. (3) JURNL assets/manifests split across two roots (JURNL/ and src/projects/jurnl/families/). (4) 41 of ~216 tables are never referenced; several intended homes (existing_location_*, creative_entries, design bridge, references, invalidation) are bypassed by in-memory Map stores (existing location, expression engine entries/chapters, design control plane, page family approvals, product asset factory) — data lost on restart. (5) New RLS findings beyond known: site00_astral_avatars has a policy but RLS never enabled; site00_production_dependency_edges and site00_production_invalidation_events have no RLS. (6) expression-engine, experience-engine and astral-world-assets handlers have no auth guard; expression-engine exposes live-generation actions. (7) Single public storage bucket 'live-preview' (created public at runtime) for all assets. (8) BLDR classes in code are SITE/WORLD/ENTERPRISE/NOT-SURE — no SYSTEMS/EXTENSIONS. IDNTY 00-03 exists as config. Unused-table detection = grep -w over .ts/.tsx/.mjs (excluding tests); dynamic table names could hide a few, hence MEDIUM confidence on that list.
